about: Blender's mesh tools, one node each in the flow editor. Each takes a model, runs one tool in Blender (in the background, no window) and hands on an FBX. scripts/blender_mesh.py runs them; crates/amald/src/flow.rs makes the nodes from this list.

ops.title: Make watertight
ops.about: Rebuilds the model as one closed surface (OpenVDB voxel remesh, the standard fix for image-to-3D triangle soup): no holes, no non-manifold edges - what retopology, reduce and rigging need

widgets.name: detail
widgets.about: voxels across the longest side - higher keeps finer shapes (and makes more faces)

ops.title: Quad remesh
ops.about: QuadriFlow, Blender's quad retopology: clean, even quads at the face count you set - a base for UVs, rigging and sculpting (made watertight first if it is not)

ops.title: Decimate
ops.about: Collapse decimation to a triangle budget - works on any mesh, keeps the shape

ops.title: Merge by distance
ops.about: Vertices closer than the distance become one (seams a file format split)

ops.title: Symmetrize
ops.about: One side mirrored onto the other across the model's middle (X = 0), the seam merged; made one closed surface again where the halves overlap

widgets.name: sides
widgets.about: largest hole to fill, in edges (0 = any)

ops.title: Smooth (keep volume)
ops.about: Laplacian smoothing that keeps the volume: noise and lumps go, the shape stays

ops.title: Triangulate
ops.about: Every face split into triangles (the best-looking diagonal)

ops.title: Recalculate normals
ops.about: Every face turned to face outwards

ops.title: Remove small pieces
ops.about: Loose pieces smaller than a share of the biggest one go

widgets.name: keep
widgets.about: a piece smaller than this share of the biggest goes

ops.title: UV unwrap
ops.about: Smart UV Project and pack: fresh UVs for baking

widgets.name: angle
widgets.about: faces at a sharper angle than this get their own island (degrees)

ops.title: Shade smooth
ops.about: Smooth shading, edges sharper than the angle stay hard
